QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Traces of the Antellion
QuestInfo.0: Elpam has a request that will help further his research into Naricain's Blood, which seems to give off an energy oddly similar to that of the Antellion. See what he needs your assistance with.
QuestInfo.1: Elpam wants to gather ecological information from Masteria's highest-level predator for analysis. Collect soil samples from Masteria.
QuestInfo.2: You collected the requested samples and delivered them to Elpam, whose analysis revealed that the mineral accumulated from Naricain's Blood eventually forms an ore called Lianium.

item.0: The ecological sample is the key. Can you check if you have it?

mob.0: The most useful thing you could do right now is defeat Aggressive Gryphons around Where the Cliff Splits and collect ecological samples from them.
